steps.name: script
script: TIMEFORMAT='TIMING docker-info %R'; time docker info --format 'docker info: storage driver {{.Driver}}, cgroup v{{.CgroupVersion}} ({{.CgroupDriver}}), registry mirrors {{.RegistryConfig.Mirrors}}'

TIMEFORMAT='TIMING kind-cluster %R'; time { if command -v flr-kind-cluster >/dev/null; then flr-kind-cluster; else docker pull -q "$KIND_NODE_IMAGE" && kind create cluster --name "$KIND_CLUSTER_NAME" --image "$KIND_NODE_IMAGE" --config "$KIND_CONFIG" --kubeconfig "$KUBECONFIG_PATH" --wait 5m; fi; }
TIMEFORMAT='TIMING nginx-ready %R'; time kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/nginx --timeout=5m
for u in guest-agent flr-registry-mirror containerd docker; do echo "BOOT $u $(( $(systemctl show -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value $u.service) / 1000 )) ms"; done
journalctl -b -o short-monotonic --no-pager -u containerd -u docker | head -80 || true
